question.text: A 5-year bond with Rs. 10 lakh face value, 8% annual coupon, YTM 10%. Price approximately:

explanation.text: The Logic: PV of coupons + PV of face value. At 10% discount vs 8% coupon → below par. Exact: Rs. 9,24,183 (check with PVIFA). The Trap: Par = Rs. 10 lakh; premium/discount depends on YTM vs coupon. Cross-Exam Context: IV bond pricing. Manager's Pro-Tip: When YTM > coupon → discount; YTM < coupon → premium. Memorise.
